_comment: Catalog of standalone environment props. width (px) is a deliberate size calibration - the source art has no consistent scale relative to a character or to each other, since every prop was generated independently; height follows automatically, keeping the source aspect ratio. blocksMovement (default true if omitted) marks solid objects a character can't walk through - only low, flat, walk-over-able ground decoration is false. `name` (display title) and `description` (examine flavor text, added 2026-09-10; rewritten in a broader comedic-adventure-game voice 2026-09-21) back GameScene::interactWithNearby()'s prop-examine path: pressing E near a spawned prop with no NPC closer shows `name`/`description` via showInfoMessage(), exactly like the built-in compass item, no scripting required. Every prop in this file has both - if a future prop is added without them, examine falls back to the catalog key itself rather than failing.

cottage_a.name: Snug Cottage
cottage_a.description: Nice cottage. Thatched roof, crooked chimney, and a strong smell of somebody definitely being home and definitely not answering the door.

cottage_b.name: Weathered Cottage
cottage_b.description: This house has given up on standing up straight and honestly, fair enough.

well.name: Village Well
well.description: You could throw a coin in and make a wish. You could also just listen to it hum ominously, which is free and much more informative.

fence_straight.name: Wooden Fence
fence_straight.description: A fence. It keeps goats in the same way a screen door keeps out determination.

fence_corner.name: Fence Corner
fence_corner.description: Two fences meet here and neither will admit whose job it was to build the gate.

market_stall.name: Market Stall
market_stall.description: Closed. The bread is long gone, but the smell filed for squatter's rights and won.

haystack.name: Haystack
haystack.description: A perfectly good haystack, and also, statistically, a pitchfork's final resting place. You do not go looking.

signpost.name: Signpost
signpost.description: One arm says ADVENTURE. The other says SAFETY. Neither one has ever been right about anything.

cart.name: Farm Cart
cart.description: Squeaks in what Lara insists is a musical key. It is not a musical key. Lara will not be told this.

barrels_crates.name: Barrels & Crates
barrels_crates.description: A stack of barrels and crates, organized using the ancient technique of 'throw it near the other ones.'

chicken_coop.name: Chicken Coop
chicken_coop.description: Suspiciously chicken-free. Either they're on strike or they know something about today that Lara doesn't.

windmill.name: Windmill
windmill.description: Spinning steadily with no wind whatsoever. The village noticed this decades ago and unanimously voted to change the subject.

blacksmith_forge.name: Blacksmith's Forge
blacksmith_forge.description: Cold and dark, and yet the anvil rings if you knock on it, like it's answering the door for someone who isn't home.

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.description: Small, plain, suspiciously cozy year-round. Somebody, or something, keeps the thermostat set to 'divine.'

water_trough.name: Water Trough
water_trough.description: Clean. Algae-free. Sitting outside catching bugs, dust, and the occasional bad decision, and yet - immaculate. Suspicious.

wheelbarrow.name: Wheelbarrow
wheelbarrow.description: Tipped over at the exact angle of a household argument nobody finished.

vegetable_garden.name: Vegetable Garden
vegetable_garden.description: Turnips growing with more enthusiasm than the actual soil quality legally allows.

bench.name: Wooden Bench
bench.description: One person sat here for so many years they wore a butt-shaped groove into destiny itself.

dovecote.name: Dovecote
dovecote.description: Pigeon condos. Rent's free, the neighbors are loud, and the reviews are, you guessed it, for the birds.

notice_board.name: Notice Board
notice_board.description: Six 'lost cat' flyers and one hand-drawn treasure map that is, quote, '100% real, ask for Gerald.'

pine_tree.name: Pine Tree
pine_tree.description: A tall, green, extremely chill tree, blissfully unaware there's something humming underneath its own roots.

oak_tree.name: Old Oak
oak_tree.description: Older than the village, and clearly planning to outlive whoever's currently arguing about property lines under it.

dead_tree.name: Dead Tree
dead_tree.description: Bare branches reaching hopefully skyward. The sky has read the message and is choosing not to reply.

burnt_stump.name: Burnt Stump
burnt_stump.description: Scorched black and hollow. Lightning, probably. Or something with a grudge and terrible aim.

bush.name: Bush
bush.description: A bush. It's rustling slightly more than the breeze can explain. This is either wildlife or a poorly hidden goblin. Statistically, it's the goblin.

rocks_small.name: Loose Rocks
rocks_small.description: A tidy little pile of rocks, doing the one job rocks are qualified for, and doing it beautifully.

boulder_large.name: Large Boulder
boulder_large.description: This boulder is currently locked in a staring contest with gravity. Gravity blinked first roughly four hundred years ago.

fallen_log.name: Fallen Log
fallen_log.description: Soft, mossy, and inexplicably warm to the touch, which is either cozy fungus or a sleeping something. Do not sit on it to find out.

reeds.name: Reeds
reeds.description: Whispering to each other in a rhythm that is almost a language, and definitely gossip about Lara specifically.

wildflowers.name: Wildflowers
wildflowers.description: Pretty little flowers in colors that don't exist in any dye book, paint set, or reasonable explanation.

cliff_face.name: Cliff Face
cliff_face.description: A tall drop with a long way down and an even longer, more awkward way to explain how you got there in the first place.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.description: Loud, cold, and thankfully drowning out the hum for a few blessed seconds. Ten out of ten, would stand under again.

wooden_bridge.name: Wooden Bridge
wooden_bridge.description: Creaks like it's dying with every single step. This is, apparently, just a personality quirk and not a warning.

tree_stump.name: Tree Stump
tree_stump.description: Perfectly good seating, and a free counting exercise if you're the sort of person who enjoys tallying up to 'unreasonable.'

berry_bush.name: Berry Bush
berry_bush.description: Heavy with berries that are either delicious or a valuable lesson about reading labels. Lara is out of labels.

lily_pads.name: Lily Pads
lily_pads.description: A neat little raft of lily pads supporting exactly one very smug, very unbothered frog.

mushroom_cluster.name: Mushroom Cluster
mushroom_cluster.description: Glowing softly for reasons that are, medically speaking, none of Lara's business.

snowy_pine.name: Snow-Dusted Pine
snowy_pine.description: Standing very, very still under all that snow, like it's hoping nobody will notice it and ask it to shovel anything.

ivy_rock.name: Ivy-Covered Rock
ivy_rock.description: Technically a rock. Legally, at this point, mostly ivy with a rock-shaped opinion.

anthill.name: Anthill
anthill.description: A miniature city-state run with a level of bureaucratic efficiency the village well could learn from.

data_pillar.name: Data Pillar
data_pillar.description: Buzzing with old information nobody's read since it was new information. Extremely relatable.

holo_terminal.name: Holo-Terminal
holo_terminal.description: Flickers to life the moment you approach, then displays nothing useful whatsoever. A truly universal terminal experience.

downed_drone.name: Downed Drone
downed_drone.description: One bent rotor, zero enthusiasm, having an objectively worse day than everyone else standing around it.

conduit_coil.name: Conduit Coil
conduit_coil.description: Warm, humming, and playing that exact same note again. At this point it's basically the local radio station.

overgrown_solar_array.name: Overgrown Solar Array
overgrown_solar_array.description: Vines have taken it over completely and, weirdly, seem to be doing the maintenance better than the last owners did.

dormant_sentry_turret.name: Dormant Sentry Turret
dormant_sentry_turret.description: Powered down and pointed at nothing. Please continue to be nothing in particular for a while longer.

cyber_supply_crate.name: Cyber Supply Crate
cyber_supply_crate.description: Sealed shut, labeled in a language nobody local speaks, and heavier than a crate has any business being. Great.

signal_relay_mast.name: Signal Relay Mast
signal_relay_mast.description: Still broadcasting faithfully to an audience that unsubscribed generations ago. Somebody get this mast an agent.

salvage_pile.name: Salvage Pile
salvage_pile.description: A heap of scrap, at least three pieces of which are absolutely, definitely still live. Poke carefully, or better, don't.

vendor_kiosk.name: Vendor Kiosk
vendor_kiosk.description: Dark, dead, abandoned - except for that one unsettling flicker that looked exactly like it recognized Lara personally.

haunted_cottage.name: Haunted Cottage
haunted_cottage.description: The door is closed now. It was wide open a second ago. Moving briskly on, thank you.

withered_well.name: Withered Well
withered_well.description: Bone dry and colder than an empty hole in the ground has any physical right to be.

broken_fence.name: Broken Fence
broken_fence.description: Snapped clean from the inside. Whatever came through here was not asking politely.

gravestone_cluster.name: Gravestone Cluster
gravestone_cluster.description: Every name has worn away completely, which honestly might be a mercy for everyone involved, including the reader.

dead_twisted_tree.name: Twisted Dead Tree
dead_twisted_tree.description: Bent into a shape no self-respecting tree would ever pick voluntarily. Whatever grew it had a very bad attitude.

will_o_wisp.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
will_o_wisp.description: A cheerful little light that stays juuust out of reach. Every story about following one of these ends with someone in a bog.

cobweb_cart.name: Cobweb-Draped Cart
cobweb_cart.description: Hasn't moved in years, and the local spiders have very much claimed squatter's rights on the whole thing.

haunted_signpost.name: Leaning Signpost
haunted_signpost.description: Both arms now point the exact same direction: away. Somebody should really ask what from.

rotted_haystack.name: Rotted Haystack
rotted_haystack.description: Black, slumped, and held together purely by mildew and bad memories. It has seen things.

ruined_chapel.name: Ruined Chapel
ruined_chapel.description: Roof caved in, pews on their sides. Whatever people prayed for here, the management regrets to inform you it did not go through.

burnt_cottage_ruin.name: Burnt Cottage Ruin
burnt_cottage_ruin.description: Charred beams still reaching up, like the house is protesting on principle even after losing the argument entirely.

rubble_pile.name: Rubble Pile
rubble_pile.description: A heap of broken stone that used to be a building and has fully, calmly accepted its new career as a heap.

charred_tree.name: Charred Tree
charred_tree.description: Black from root to crown. Whatever burned this did not come from anywhere near the sun, and left no return address.

wrecked_cart.name: Wrecked Cart
wrecked_cart.description: Missing a wheel entirely. The remaining three are maintaining a united front that this is somehow fine.

scorched_fence_remains.name: Scorched Fence Remains
scorched_fence_remains.description: A handful of blackened posts, faithfully guarding a plot of land with absolutely nothing left worth guarding.

impact_crater.name: Impact Crater
impact_crater.description: Scorched middle, glassy edges, zero explanation. Something landed here hard and nobody's filed the paperwork.

collapsed_well.name: Collapsed Well
collapsed_well.description: Fell in on itself completely. Whatever's at the bottom now has excellent, permanent privacy.

ash_covered_barrels.name: Ash-Covered Barrels
ash_covered_barrels.description: Gray with soot and stacked hastily, the exact packing job of people who left in a screaming hurry.

destroyed_market_stall.name: Wrecked Market Stall
destroyed_market_stall.description: Splintered boards, a torn awning, and a business plan that did not survive contact with whatever happened here.

fallen_watchtower.name: Fallen Watchtower
fallen_watchtower.description: Toppled clean over. Still keeping watch, technically, just now exclusively over the dirt directly beneath it.

leaning_tenement.name: Leaning Tenement
leaning_tenement.description: Standing purely out of spite and an unspoken agreement with the wall it is absolutely not supposed to be leaning on.

laundry_line.name: Laundry Line
laundry_line.description: Strung between two buildings, still holding one shirt whose owner is, at this point, presumed to not be coming back for it.

poor_market_stall.name: Modest Market Stall
poor_market_stall.description: Threadbare canvas, a few honest goods, and more genuine pride in the arrangement than the fanciest stall in the capital.

rain_barrel.name: Rain Barrel
rain_barrel.description: Catches every drop that falls from the sky, which is either thrifty or the only water anyone around here still trusts.

crate_tarp_shanty.name: Crate-and-Tarp Shanty
crate_tarp_shanty.description: Somebody's entire home, built from other people's leftovers and held together by pure stubbornness. Respect.

patched_pushcart.name: Patched Pushcart
patched_pushcart.description: Repaired so many times it's less 'one cart' now and more 'a committee of spare parts that agreed to travel together.'

street_water_pump.name: Street Water Pump
street_water_pump.description: Squeaks loudly going up, quietly going down. The entire street knows exactly who's fetching water, and when.

crate_stack_cat.name: Crate Stack (Occupied)
crate_stack_cat.description: A tidy stack of crates, now the sovereign territory of a cat who owns them, the alley, and by extension, you.

alley_lantern_post.name: Alley Lantern Post
alley_lantern_post.description: Provides just enough light to see the alley, and just little enough to sincerely wish it hadn't.

beggars_bedroll.name: Bedroll
beggars_bedroll.description: Rolled out neat and careful against the wall - the one thing here designed to be grabbed and gone in five seconds flat.

wooden_bed.name: Wooden Bed
wooden_bed.description: Simple, sturdy, and mysteriously far comfier than a plank with a blanket thrown over it has any right to be.

dining_table_chairs.name: Dining Table & Chairs
dining_table_chairs.description: Set for far more people than currently live here. Old habit, quiet hope, or somebody's terrible at counting.

stone_fireplace.name: Stone Fireplace
stone_fireplace.description: Cold and dark, but the stones still hold a bit of warmth, like they're keeping the seat warm for fire's eventual return.

wooden_chest.name: Wooden Chest
wooden_chest.description: Locked tight and radiating the very specific energy of an object with strong personal opinions about being opened.

tavern_bar_counter.name: Tavern Bar Counter
tavern_bar_counter.description: Scarred with a hundred forgotten toasts and one axe mark that the bartender changes the subject about every single time.

stacked_ale_barrels.name: Stacked Ale Barrels
stacked_ale_barrels.description: Three barrels high and precisely one bad decision away from becoming two barrels wide and one barrel very upset.

bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Packed with books on subjects nobody in this town admits to caring about. Somebody, clearly, cared a great deal.

standing_torch_sconce.name: Standing Torch Sconce
standing_torch_sconce.description: Burns steady and bright in drafts strong enough to knock over lesser candles. Overachiever.

barred_cell_section.name: Barred Cell
barred_cell_section.description: Currently empty. The bars are sturdy. Lara's confidence about that staying true is, at best, a work in progress.

throne.name: Throne
throne.description: Extremely ornate, extremely uncomfortable, and built entirely to be looked at rather than, say, sat in during a long meeting.

castle_wall_section.name: Castle Wall
castle_wall_section.description: Thick gray stone that has shrugged off more sieges, weather, and bad poetry than most people learn about in a lifetime.

castle_gate_tower.name: Gate Tower
castle_gate_tower.description: Tall enough to spot trouble coming from a mile off, assuming the night guard hasn't wandered down for a snack again.

drawbridge.name: Drawbridge
drawbridge.description: Down. This either means visitors are warmly welcomed, or nobody remembered how the crank works.

portcullis.name: Portcullis
portcullis.description: A wall of iron teeth, currently open wide and grinning about it in a way that feels deliberately unsettling.

corner_turret.name: Corner Turret
corner_turret.description: A narrow tower with a spectacular view and, judging by the abandoned mug up there, an extremely cold, extremely lonely night shift.

castle_banner_wallmount.name: Castle Banner
castle_banner_wallmount.description: Hangs heavy and dead still, in air that has apparently, unanimously, decided not to move it.

siege_ballista.name: Siege Ballista
siege_ballista.description: Aimed squarely at the horizon by someone who clearly took the horizon's existence as a personal insult.

courtyard_well.name: Courtyard Well
courtyard_well.description: Deeper and considerably better maintained than the village well. Royalty, it turns out, extends even to plumbing.

armory_rack.name: Armory Rack
armory_rack.description: Rows of gleaming, freshly oiled weapons that have clearly seen far more polishing than actual combat.

castle_stairs.name: Castle Stairs
castle_stairs.description: Worn smooth into a gentle curve by centuries of important people in a hurry to be somewhere even more important.

stalactite_cluster.name: Stalactite Cluster
stalactite_cluster.description: Dripping on a schedule that has had several thousand years to get really, unnervingly precise about it.

stalagmite_formation.name: Stalagmite Formation
stalagmite_formation.description: Slowly, patiently rising to meet its ceiling counterpart, one drop of mineral at a time. Commitment.

underground_pool.name: Underground Pool
underground_pool.description: Still, dark, and clear enough to see uncomfortably far down. Nothing about that depth invites a closer look.

cave_in_rubble.name: Cave-In Rubble
cave_in_rubble.description: A solid wall of collapsed rock where a tunnel used to be. It is now, structurally speaking, extremely done being a tunnel.

glowing_crystal_cluster.name: Glowing Crystal Cluster
glowing_crystal_cluster.description: Pulsing with light from no visible source, and declining, politely but firmly, to explain itself further.

mine_cart.name: Mine Cart
mine_cart.description: Rusted solid to its rails, still loaded with ore nobody ever bothered to come back for. Somebody's getting docked pay.

support_beam.name: Support Beam
support_beam.description: Groans occasionally under the weight of the whole mountain above it, purely, one hopes, for dramatic effect.

underground_fungus_growth.name: Underground Fungus Growth
underground_fungus_growth.description: Pale, spongy, and thriving somewhere sunlight has never once bothered to show up. Best of luck to it.

cave_torch_sconce.name: Cave Torch Sconce
cave_torch_sconce.description: Lit and burning steadily. Nobody down here has admitted to lighting it, and nobody's asking twice.

bat_roost.name: Bat Roost
bat_roost.description: Quiet for now. This is exactly the kind of quiet you should not interrupt with a loud noise, a torch, or a sneeze.

runic_standing_stone.name: Runic Standing Stone
runic_standing_stone.description: Carved with symbols older than every language spoken here today, and somehow, infuriatingly, still perfectly legible.

broken_arcane_statue.name: Broken Arcane Statue
broken_arcane_statue.description: Missing an arm and most of its face, and still somehow radiating the exact posture of profound disappointment.

ley_light_wisp_cluster.name: Ley-Light Wisps
ley_light_wisp_cluster.description: Little lights drifting in slow loops that might be an ancient pattern or might just be showing off for an audience of one.

sunken_archway.name: Sunken Archway
sunken_archway.description: Half-buried in earth, still leading to a door that mattered enormously to somebody, once upon a very long time ago.

rune_circle.name: Rune Circle
rune_circle.description: Etched into the ground in a perfect ring. Stepping into the middle of it feels less like an accident and more like signing something.

ancient_obelisk.name: Ancient Obelisk
ancient_obelisk.description: Stands taller than physics really allows, given how little of it is actually touching the ground. Best not to ask twice.

shattered_mirror_shard.name: Shattered Mirror Shard
shattered_mirror_shard.description: Reflects the sky perfectly on time. Reflects Lara about half a second behind. That gap is doing a lot of unspoken work.

moss_grown_altar.name: Moss-Grown Altar
moss_grown_altar.description: Whatever used to be offered here, the moss has enthusiastically taken over the job with zero supervision required.

buried_relic_case.name: Buried Relic Case
buried_relic_case.description: Sealed tight and half-sunk in dirt, guarding something somebody once decided was worth protecting forever. Forever's still going.

whispering_well.name: Whispering Well
whispering_well.description: Lean in close and it whispers back. Never quite words. Never quite nothing. Extremely unhelpful, extremely committed to being spooky about it.

distant_treeline.name: Distant Treeline
distant_treeline.description: Forest stretching to the horizon, hazy with distance and thoroughly, comfortably somebody else's problem.

misty_ridge.name: Misty Ridge
misty_ridge.description: A ridge of hills wrapped permanently in fog that has never once lifted, burned off, or offered so much as a hint why.

distant_hills.name: Distant Hills
distant_hills.description: Rolling and blue-gray with distance, and either closer than they look or exactly as far as they look. Nobody's actually checked.

dense_treeline.name: Dense Treeline
dense_treeline.description: A wall of dark forest at the edge of everything, thick enough to swallow both sound and any lingering sense of a good idea.

misty_peaks.name: Misty Peaks
misty_peaks.description: Mountains fading into cloud at the top, as if even the mountains got nervous about committing to a final height.

stone_wall_corner.name: Stone Wall Corner
stone_wall_corner.description: Two walls meeting at a crisp right angle, exactly as walls have unanimously agreed to behave since the invention of walls.

stone_wall_corner_alt.name: Stone Wall Corner
stone_wall_corner_alt.description: The other corner. Structurally identical to its twin. Aesthetically, it insists there is a difference, and refuses to elaborate.

stone_archway.name: Stone Archway
stone_archway.description: A doorway with no door installed, which somehow reads less like an oversight and more like a very deliberate decision.

stone_wall_window.name: Stone Wall Window
stone_wall_window.description: A narrow slit built for archers to shoot arrows through, not for anyone hoping to admire a view. Manage expectations.

wall_torch_sconce.name: Wall Torch Sconce
wall_torch_sconce.description: Mounted at precisely the height needed to leave a permanent soot stain on the ceiling directly above it. Every single time.

wall_tapestry.name: Wall Tapestry
wall_tapestry.description: Depicts a battle, or a feast, or possibly both simultaneously, depending entirely on how long and how hard you squint at it.

stone_wall_skirting.name: Stone Wall Skirting
stone_wall_skirting.description: The dull little strip where wall meets floor. Somebody, inexplicably, still carved it with real loving care.

cracked_stone_floor.name: Cracked Stone Floor
cracked_stone_floor.description: Cracked in a pattern that looks less like ordinary wear and more like something underneath tried to push its way up. Watch that.

floor_rubble_patch.name: Floor Rubble Patch
floor_rubble_patch.description: A scattering of broken stone underfoot that has, frankly, not finished settling and would appreciate you not testing that theory.

worn_floor_rug.name: Worn Floor Rug
worn_floor_rug.description: Threadbare dead in the center from what must have been an absolutely heroic amount of nervous pacing.
